body: Fix the mismatch between the modeled high-GH penalty and the failure diagnostics. `crates/tank_core/src/systems/shrimp.rs:1389-1400` reduces `molt_mineral_modifier()` when `gh_d > gh_max_d`, which can push a healthy shrimp below `molt_success_threshold`. But `emit_molt_failure()` at `crates/tank_core/src/systems/shrimp.rs:1180-1232` only reports low GH/Ca/Mg and otherwise falls back to `PoorCondition`, so a very hard-water failure can be logged as `condition 1.00` even though the modeled driver was excessive GH. Either surface a high-GH/high-mineral diagnostic or remove the above-range GH penalty from the molt mechanic.
